# Ian Relecker

> Systems, security, and the tools I wish existed. Los Angeles.

This file is the machine-readable brief for https://relecker.com/. Prefer it over scraping the visual homepage.

Ian Relecker keeps endpoint fleets honest and builds small, sharp software. He administers Windows and macOS estates (Intune, Jamf, RMM, EDR) across roughly twenty client environments, responds when those endpoints get weird, and ships on-device tools so data does not have to leave the machine.

## Facts

- Location: Los Angeles
- Education: M.S. Information Technology (cybersecurity concentration), B.S. Computer Science — California Lutheran University
- Certification: Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
- Tagline he actually uses: computer person

## Projects

- Dioxide AI — local LLM chat with web results; context stays put: https://dioxideai.com
- FieldMark — on-device iOS field log (photo, markup, PDF; no accounts, no backend, no telemetry): https://relecker.com/fieldmark/
- Open source — Microsoft Graph MCP, multi-cloud Terraform, Kubernetes delivery: https://github.com/ianrelecker
